purpose: Energy comparison subject to the same finite-window mean aggregate backlog target
target_interpretation: Dimensionless workload-normalized aggregate backlog targets, not measured task deadlines or user QoE
selection_rule: For each method/load/target, select the scale with minimum mean energy among settings whose mean backlog in EACH selection seed is <= target. Break exact energy ties by lower mean backlog, then scale order. No interpolation or per-test-seed choice.
test_rule: Test each distinct selected method/load/scale on all five test seeds. A target passes only if EACH test seed mean backlog <= target. No parameter replacement after test failure. Compare energy at a target only between methods that both pass.
infeasible_rule: If no selection setting passes, report no feasible point in the common grid; do not claim inherent algorithm infeasibility.
completion_and_slope: Report completion-to-arrival ratio, initial/final backlog, and latter-half OLS backlog slope. These are diagnostics, not undisclosed extra selection filters or stability guarantees.
common_physics: Unchanged SimConfig hardware, orthogonal links, arrivals, slot ordering and full-slot energy; every method receives the same input arrays per load/seed.
common_cpu_rule: Cap local and edge CPU frequency to the frequency needed for the original chosen useful service, before evaluating the same full-slot cubic energy. All six methods use this rule.
new_method: QAPG-R minimizes conditional expected next weighted quadratic device/server queues plus fixed V energy, by joint local/upload/server block updates and edge-service updates. Edge queue weight is M/N, fixed from pool size before any trajectory runs. Arrival mean is read from common configuration; no future arrival samples are observed. Maximum 12 sweeps, objective-scaled tolerance 1e-10. No global or stochastic optimality claim.
comparator_parameters: QAPG and NoQuad keep their adaptive weight shape with V and its floor scaled together; all other original constants retained. GUPA QoE/max-power association unchanged, CPU V tunable. EEDO fixed power and per-origin service mechanism retained. BP queue/power rule retained. No per-load algorithm parameter tuning beyond the common energy scale grid.
results_policy: Retain all grid points, targets, failures and controls. Selection frontier is labelled selection data; holdout results comprise only frozen selected operating points. Algorithm/source hashes freeze before selection; any later implementation correction invalidates affected results and is versioned.
runtime: Decision runtime is diagnostic only; no cross-method speed superiority claim.
statistics: Independent units are random seeds. Report means and sample SD across seeds; no slots-as-independent-replicates p-values, no adaptive stopping and no confidence guarantee from five seeds.
queue_weight_rationale: Device queues are per-origin while each server aggregates a nominal N/M origins. The fixed M/N normalization equals the sum of equal per-origin squared queues for a balanced pool, but is only a chosen proxy when origins are unbalanced; it is not tuned from results.
